css.desc: The actual grid. Several profiles call the grid their first move and then had nothing to build it with. Columns and gutter come from the style's tokens.
Binds the computed type scale, leading and measure to real elements, so the style's size budget is what the page uses.
Matte navigation bar for styles that forbid glass. Same job as navbar-glass with no backdrop-filter and no translucency.
Asymmetric flush-left hero on the grid — the counterpart to hero-centered for styles whose rule is 'never centre'.
Frosted-glass panel with blur, inner sheen, and soft border.
Glossy Frutiger-Aero gel button with top highlight sheen.
Neon glow for text and outlined buttons (uses currentColor).
Vaporwave hero: sunset gradient with a perspective grid floor.
CRT scanline + flicker overlay. Put over any container.
A 5-step soft shadow elevation scale (utility classes).
Centered hero section with fluid headline.
Lifting feature card with an accent icon chip. Uses your tokens.
Text input with an accent focus ring. Uses your tokens.

animations.desc: Typewriter reveal with a blinking caret (single line).
RGB-split glitch on text. Set data-text to the same string.
Neon sign flicker — irregular blinks then steady glow.
Animated gradient sweeping through heading text.
Per-letter bobbing wave. Wrap each letter in <span> and set delays.
Gentle floating bob — great for glossy icons/bubbles.
Breathing glow to draw attention to a button/badge.
Standard entrance: fade + rise. Add to elements on load.
Rising translucent bubbles on a <canvas id='bubbles'> — Frutiger Aero.
Falling green code rain on a <canvas id='matrix'>.
Warp starfield flying toward the viewer on <canvas id='stars'>.

gradients.css: radial-gradient(at 20% 20%, #ff71ce 0px, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 80% 0%, #01cdfe 0px, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 0% 80%, #05ffa1 0px, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 80% 100%, #b967ff 0px, transparent 50%), #1a1a2e
radial-gradient(at 75% 15%, rgba(199,125,255,0.25) 0px, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 15% 80%, rgba(138,112,255,0.30) 0px, transparent 55%), linear-gradient(160deg, #0a0618 0%, #150e2e 100%)
radial-gradient(at 50% 110%, rgba(255,107,53,0.35) 0px, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(at 85% 20%, rgba(255,193,94,0.12) 0px, transparent 45%), linear-gradient(180deg, #140d0a 0%, #241511 100%)
radial-gradient(at 72% 8%, rgba(217,180,83,0.13) 0px, transparent 45%), radial-gradient(at 18% 85%, rgba(32,42,92,0.55) 0px, transparent 55%), linear-gradient(180deg, #04070f 0%, #0a1224 100%)

radial-gradient(at 27% 37%, #ffd1dc 0px, transparent 45%), radial-gradient(at 97% 21%, #c7ceea 0px, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(at 52% 99%, #b5ead7 0px, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(at 10% 90%, #ffe5b4 0px, transparent 40%), #fff5e1

patterns.desc: Polka-dot grid. Change color/size via the two values.
Film-grain overlay (SVG feTurbulence data-URI). Put on a positioned parent; tweak opacity to taste.
Wave section divider. Set a color via `fill`/currentColor; place at the bottom of a section.
Organic blob shape — decorative accent behind content.
Concentric contour lines — subtle map-like texture.

svg_art.desc: 16 stroke icons as a hidden <symbol> sprite. Drop once, then reuse: <svg class='ic'><use href='#i-home'/></svg>. Style .ic { width:24px; height:24px; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
Two soft overlapping blobs — decorative hero backdrop. Recolor via the two fills; set position:absolute behind content.
Layered geometric hills/mountains scene — clean generic hero art. Swap the layer fills to match any palette.
Synthwave sun + perspective grid horizon — retro/cyberpunk hero.

layouts.desc: One centered, measure-limited column. The most readable layout.
Full-viewport hero: big headline, subcopy, primary + ghost CTA.

layouts.best_for: landing pages with a few key points
layouts.desc: Alternating left/right rows guide the eye in a Z — image ⇄ text.
Left-aligned headings + text blocks matching natural F-scan reading.

layouts.best_for: portfolios, two equal choices, product vs pricing
layouts.desc: 50/50 vertical split — two panels of equal weight side by side.

layouts.best_for: web apps, docs with nav, settings
layouts.desc: Fixed left sidebar + fluid content — the classic app shell.
Responsive auto-fit card grid — columns adapt to width.
Trendy 'bento box' grid — mixed-size tiles in one frame.
Asymmetric multi-column with a lead story — magazine feel.
Scroll-snap sections that each fill the viewport.
Topbar + sidebar + content metric grid — full admin shell.
Uneven-height items packed in balanced columns (CSS columns).

techniques.desc: Rotating conic-gradient border via @property (Houdini). The signature 'this isn't a default template' border.
Soft drifting aurora — 3 blurred color blobs behind content. Replaces the flat one-gradient hero.
Smoothly cycle a heading's hue with an animated custom property.
Stacked shadows that fake real light falloff — far softer/richer than one hard drop shadow (the #1 generic tell).
Soft-UI dual light/dark shadow so elements extrude from the bg.
Extruded 3D text via a stack of offset shadows.
Perspective tilt on hover — pairs with the spotlight-hover JS.
Radial glow that follows the cursor across a card (CSS + 4 lines JS).
Break the rectangle — diagonal sections, hexagons, arrows via clip-path.
Organic blob that slowly morphs — great as a decorative mask/backdrop.
Gradient masks: fade edges, and knock an image out through text.
A mask that wipes open as the element scrolls into view (no JS).
Gooey merge filter — blobs/menu items melt together (SVG filter + CSS).
Film-grain over the whole page — instant analog richness. Default STATIC (free); the animated variant repaints a 2x-viewport fixed layer ~7x/sec and visibly janks pages that also use blurs/filters.
Duotone any image into two brand colors (SVG feColorMatrix map).
RGB-split chromatic aberration on hover — subtle digital-glitch edge.
Turbulence + displacement for a liquid/heat-haze distortion on hover.
Layer color over imagery with blend modes (multiply/overlay/screen) for editorial compositing instead of flat overlays.
Fade + rise as elements enter the viewport — pure CSS scroll-driven animation, no IntersectionObserver.
Real parallax bound to scroll progress (no JS, no jank).
Seamless infinite marquee (duplicate the track for the loop).
Smooth morphing transitions between DOM states (View Transitions API).
Outlined (hollow) display type — huge headings without a fill.
Animate a variable font's weight/width for living, kinetic type.
Interpolate gradients in oklch so the midpoint stays vivid — no muddy gray middle you get from sRGB blends.
Derive hovers, tints, and borders from ONE brand var with color-mix() — no separate shade tokens to maintain.
Spinning iridescent/holographic sheen from an animated conic gradient.
Conic progress ring with a masked hole and a smoothly animatable %.
Proper frosted glass: blur+saturate, a top sheen, and a light inner border — not just a translucent white box.
A REAL gradient border (any radius) via mask-composite — no padding-box hack, content keeps its own background.
Draw pixel art with box-shadow (one shadow = one pixel), scaled up.
Tether a tooltip/popover to an element with CSS anchor positioning — no JS positioning math.
Style a component by ITS OWN width, not the viewport — real reusable responsive components.
Make card internals (title/body/footer) line up ACROSS cards with subgrid.
A snappy horizontal carousel with zero JS.
Cards that pin and stack under each other as you scroll (the 'deck' effect).
Soft bloom/neon glow around anything (SVG blur + merge filter).
Comic/print halftone dot texture over a fill (blend a dot grid).
Scrub a hero animation to scroll position (zoom/pan a background as you scroll) — scroll-timeline, no JS.
A list whose items reveal one-by-one as each enters view (natural stagger, no per-item JS delays).
Header that condenses + frosts as you scroll — driven by scroll progress, not a JS scroll listener.
3D flip card (front/back) on hover.
Springy overshoot with the new linear() easing — bouncy motion without a physics lib.
A light sheen that sweeps across a card/button on hover (glossy).
Style a parent from its children/state with :has() — quantity queries, form validity, active card, all with no JS.
Accessible accordion/disclosure with zero JS using <details>.
Flow text along a curved SVG path — badges, seals, kinetic headers.
Derive tints/shades/alpha from ONE color with Relative Color Syntax — generate a whole ramp from a single brand var.
Automatic light/dark values with the light-dark() function — one declaration, both modes, no media query.
True smooth mesh gradient (SVG) — richer than layered radials.
Apple-style squircle corners with corner-shape: superellipse (smoother than border-radius).
Letterpress/emboss text — carved into or raised off the surface.
Wrap paragraph text around a circle/blob — real magazine flow.
Animate clip-path to wipe/morph a reveal (transition or keyframes).
Native Popover API — menus/tooltips/dialogs with top-layer + backdrop and zero JS.
Auto-growing inputs/textareas with field-sizing: content — no JS resize hack.
Pure-CSS tabs (radio inputs + :has) — no JavaScript.
Full CRT monitor look — scanlines + vignette + subtle flicker.
Living organic background (marble / clouds / smoke) via animated SVG feTurbulence.
Realistic frosted glass = backdrop blur + a faint noise grain on top.
A reading-progress bar that fills with page scroll — pure CSS scroll-timeline.
Multi-depth parallax — background/mid/foreground move at different speeds, all scroll-driven.
Reveal a heading line-by-line (each line rises out of a clip) as it enters view.
Circular text badge that slowly rotates (each letter positioned around a ring).
Real drop cap with initial-letter — sinks the first letter across N lines like print.
Pro typographic line-breaking: balanced headlines, no orphans in body copy.
Procedural backgrounds with the CSS Paint API (Houdini worklet) — draw anything (confetti, waves, noise) as a CSS background.

The anti-bubble card: cut-corner plate (clip-path) with an accent notch strip, hairline inset edge, drop-shadow depth that follows the shape, and a corner-cut morph on hover. Use INSTEAD of rounded 'glass bubble' cards — the #1 generic-AI-site tell.
Sharp cut-corner CTA — replaces the default 999px pill button (the other generic-AI tell). Uppercase display type, clipped corners, drop-shadow depth.

Boxless floating text section — a glowing spine rule + ghost stroke-word backdrop + a larger lede paragraph instead of wrapping prose in yet another rounded card. Use for manifesto/about/narrative sections, especially near the top of the page.

creative.desc: Full-screen animated GLSL fragment-shader background (GPU). Swap the fragment for aurora/plasma/noise — this is the un-templatey hero backdrop CSS can't do.
Three.js hero: a faceted metallic solid with real lighting. Swap geometry/material for glass, torus knots, etc.
Play a designer-made After Effects animation (Lottie JSON) — pro motion for near-zero effort. Grab .json files from lottiefiles.com.
Anime.js timeline with staggered entrance — sequencing CSS can't do.
Motion One spring physics — natural, bouncy entrances (tiny lib).
Self-drawing SVG lines/logos (animate stroke) — signature intro move.
Generative flow-field background (Perlin-noise particle streams) — endlessly unique, alive.
Hand-drawn / sketchy shapes (Rough.js) — the literal opposite of clean AI-generic. Great for playful, editorial, or zine looks.
Draggable 2D physics playground (Matter.js) — bouncy, tactile UI toys.
Generate a full perceptual color ramp from a few seed colors (bezier + corrected lightness) instead of hand-picking every stop.
Pick guaranteed-readable text colors and enforce WCAG AA contrast programmatically — no more failing color combos.
Map data values to colors with a perceptual (lab) scale — proper heatmaps/choropleths, not a rainbow.
Derive complementary / triadic / analogous palettes from one hue.
Use Open Props — a huge ready set of CSS variables (shadows, easings, gradients, sizes) so you never hand-tune those again.
Single source of design tokens (JSON) → build to CSS vars / JS / iOS / Android. The pro way to keep one theme across platforms.

native.desc: A complete themed desktop window (header + glass card + gel button + landing splash), style-swappable.
Glass panel with drop shadow + gradient surface + sheen. Pack content into `card.body`.
Filled action button with profile-specific material, corners, typography and enabled states.
Profile-aware title bar: matte for flat styles, polished where allowed, bubbles for Aero.
Animated landing overlay: glass title card + gradient loading bar + rising bubbles, then reveals the app.
Re-theme the whole native UI by changing one string — every generator reads the style's tokens.
Ten themed backdrop textures — grain, brushed metal, carbon weave, CRT scanlines, halftone, diagonal stripes, mesh gradient, starfield, paper — one dispatcher, any style.
Deep-space backdrop (as shipped in the Ultra Archive): accent-tinted nebula + glowing stars, themed by style.
CRT scanlines + phosphor glow — terminals, HUDs, retro-tech panels.
Brushed-metal panel: horizontal streak noise + soft sheen.
Multi-point mesh gradient (the trendy blurry-blob hero), drawn from the style's accent family automatically.
Outline-glow button (hover brightens the halo) — the dark-style counterpart to the gel button.
Profile-aware progress bar; bounded .set(0..1), visible small values, optional gloss.
Keyboard-accessible on/off switch with the profile's material and corner treatment.
Pill badges/chips in four kinds: accent, accent2, outline, surface.
Glowing status light: ok / warn / err / off — with .set_state() for live dashboards.
Engraved museum plaque strip (born in the Ultra Archive) — dark surface, accent hairline; put caption text on top.
WCAG contrast math for native UIs: measure ratios, pick readable ink, auto-fix a color until it passes — check, don't guess.
Fading accent divider + color utilities: ramp() tint→shade scales and harmony() complement/analogous/triadic — stop hand-picking 'a lighter accent'.
